setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A newly blended family tries to plan a day together.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Each person contributes a favorite game.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The choices clash, so the family takes turns.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A familiar picnic helps one child feel secure.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another child asks to invent something new.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family begins a new annual outing.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The first attempt is awkward but ends with laughter.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Everyone enjoys a little breathing room.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The family realizes they still want some shared activities.
